_comment: Categories of suggested new variables that every pack gets (variable_categories.py). A pack adds its own, or replaces one of these by id, with "variable_categories" in its pack.json. value_type: number (one number with a unit; the column gets the unit's suffix and values are converted), text (words, at most max_words), any (a number if it is one, else short text). sources: where values come from without the model choosing (species, species:initial, species:sampled, added_solution); a category without sources (or with "model_assigns": true) is one the model can assign. Pack categories are listed first.

categories.label: Metadata
categories.description: about the study or its materials rather than one experiment's conditions: chemical suppliers and purities, sample or material origin, data or code availability

categories.label: Experimental Methodology
categories.description: how the experiment was set up and run, in words: apparatus, heating or mixing method, sealing, atmosphere handling, sterilisation, sampling procedure
